result:
PR #407 is ready for review. `cloud.sh` no longer counts a claim as an attempt unless a session actually started, and it now deletes a leftover local `lane/cloud-<n>` branch only when that branch is already folded.

**What changed in `docs/testing/jobs/cloud.sh`:**
- **Attempt counter:** when the counter is written, the script now sets a trap that puts the file back exactly as it was on any exit. The trap is removed only after `systemd-run` has started the session. So all six early exits give the attempt back, not just the two that did before: worktree busy, fetch failed, the three `exit 5`, and snapshot failed. The same holds if `systemd-run` itself fails.
- **Leftover branch:** before `worktree add -b`, a local `lane/cloud-<n>` is deleted only if it is checked out in no worktree, origin does not have it, and it is an ancestor of `origin/$TIP`. The deletion is logged as one line with the sha. In any other case the branch is kept, the claim is refused, the log says why (for example "holds 1 commit(s) not on origin/master, which may be unpushed work"), and no attempt is spent.

**Proof:** I added `selftest.d/73-cloud-claim.sh`. It uses its own `HAKUX_WORK`, a scratch repo with its own origin, and its own stand-ins for gh, systemd and git. It has five cases:
- **(a)** A forced worktree failure leaves the attempts file unchanged, including over three ticks as on #271.
- **(b)** A folded leftover branch is deleted and the claim proceeds.
- **(c)** A branch with a commit not on the tip is kept.
- **(d)** An ancestor that origin still has is kept.
- **(e)** An ancestor checked out in another worktree is kept.

| run | result |
|---|---|
| `cloud.sh` from origin/master | 6 ok, 12 fail; every case fails at least once |
| this branch | 18 ok |
| full `selftest.sh` | 1785 passed, 0 failed |
| `preflight.sh` | passed, without `--allow-tracker` |

The before and after output is in `docs/lanes/cloudclaim/NOTES.md`. The PR's `Files:` line matches the diff, and there is no prediction because this is a harness script with no device run. CI has not run on the pushed head (ef6a0b6ec0) yet; the fold job will pick that up.
